name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads always had a knack for understanding how things worked, dismantling and reassembling everything he could get his hands on as a child. This curiosity led him to pursue engineering, eventually specializing in motorsport technology. He started his career in Formula 3, quickly proving his ability to optimize car performance and manage technical teams effectively. His innovative problem-solving skills caught the attention of Mercedes-AMG, where he now serves as a Technical Director.

Mads believes in a data-driven approach to motorsport, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car's performance to identify areas for improvement. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to inspire his team to push the boundaries of what's possible. He is dedicated to fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best work. Mads is distinctive because of his ability to translate complex technical issues into easily understandable terms, fostering efficient collaboration between engineers and drivers.

He's particularly interested in the application of AI to optimize car setup and race strategy. Mads is committed to sustainable motorsport technologies, constantly exploring ways to reduce the environmental impact of racing without sacrificing performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight fade.
physical.description: Mads is of average height with a lean, athletic build and intense eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and meticulously records observations during races.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Danish licorice available in the garage.
